item.coloph: li shu stag ring bdag gis kyang / dka' ba spyad pa'i gdams pa yin/ bdag gis 'di mdzad tshe lo gcig stong thub/ dam med log 'dren can la bstan pa na/ srid pa'i rgyal mos mgo khos cig 'di la them dang gab sbas med/ bka' rgyas gdab bo sa ma ya/ dam rgyas btab pa su be ka/ gsang rgyas btab pas u ya smar/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang sgrub (sgrab) 'di/ li shu stag ring bdag gi a rgya dam//
